name: Keak da Sneak
description: '''Charles Kente Williams''' ({{ne}} '''Bowens'''; born October 21, 1977), better known by his stage name '''Keak da Sneak''', is an American rapper from [[Oakland, California]]. He is best known for his guest appearance on [[E-40]]'s 2006 single "[[Tell Me When to Go]]", which peaked within the top 40 of the [[Billboard Hot 100|''Billboard'' Hot 100]]. Credited with coining the term "[[hyphy]]" in 1994, Bowens has contributed extensively to the genre and movement.
